detail: In-scope item 'Manager can reject a pending request' has no story. US-5 covers approval only, so the rejection path (status change, employee notified, balance unchanged) is neither specified nor tested.
US-4.AC1 (manager notified) has no tests at all. No T-* references it.
US-1.AC1 has only a positive test (T-1). Missing a negative case (balance service unavailable) and an edge case (zero balance).
Nothing verifies the hand-off between approval and balance: after US-5 approves a request, no test checks that US-1 shows the reduced balance or that US-3 then blocks an over-balance request.
US-5.AC1 has no negative test (a manager approving a request outside their team) and no edge test (approving twice must not deduct the balance twice).
Open question 1 (do pending requests reduce the shown balance?) is unresolved, so US-1.AC1 and US-3.AC2 could be read two ways. Resolve before build.
